basic_details.job_title: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

important_dates.interview_date: To be notified by email to shortlisted candidates

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: Maximum 28 years at the date of joining with suitable age relaxations applicable for reserved candidates as per GOI norms.

qualification.details: Experience in drone technologies Good communication skills, both in scientific writing as well as presentation

selection_process: The selection process consists of shortlisting candidates based on their merits and project requirements
followed by an interview in online or offline mode.
how_to_apply: Visit the official online application link provided in the notification.
Fill out the online application form with the required details.
Prepare all supporting documents including self-attested copies of educational qualifications, experience certificate, Aadhar card, age proof, and a CV with photo.
Attach all required supporting documents to the online application.
Submit the completed application form on or before 20 October 2026 until 11:59 pm.
important_instructions: Tenure of the project is 1.5 years or till the completion of the project, whichever is earlier. Shortlisted candidates will be informed through email about the interview date, time, and mode (online/offline). Mere possession of the minimum qualifications does not guarantee an invitation to the interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on merits and the requirements of the project. All supporting documents must be attached with the online application form.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the Project Associate-1 position under the MeitY sponsored project at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Associate-1 post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 20 October 2026 until 11:59 pm.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B.E./B.Tech in ECE/CSE/EE/ME/Aerospace with a good academic background and knowledge in UAV systems, Communication Systems, Machine Learning, Signal Processing, Sensors, Computer Vision, Drone Applications, or GPS Denied Systems.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years at the date of joining, with suitable age relaxations applicable for reserved candidates as per GOI norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply?
faq.answer: You can apply online through the provided Google Forms application link and attach all necessary supporting documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on their merits and project requirements, followed by an interview conducted in online or offline mode.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q10. What is the tenure of the project?
faq.answer: The tenure of the project is 1.5 years or till the completion of the project, whichever is earlier.
